node.statement: Orthogonality calculation from the provisioned bounds. Put t_i=||p_i||. Since M_n tensor A is an epsilon-C*-algebra and p_i is Hermitian, (1-epsilon)t_i^2<=||p_i^dagger p_i||=||p_i^2||<=t_i+rho. If e=rho+epsilon<=1/4 and t_i>=2, then (1-epsilon)t_i^2-t_i-rho is increasing for t_i>=2 and at 2 equals 2-4epsilon-rho>=1, a contradiction; hence t_i<2. For {k,l}={1,2}, bilinearity and p_1+p_2=I+r give exactly p_k p_l=p_k r+(p_k I-p_k)+(p_k-p_k^2). The product-norm and right-unit axioms, followed by the preceding bounds, yield ||p_k p_l||<=(1+epsilon)t_k||r||+epsilon t_k+||p_k^2-p_k||<=2(1+epsilon)rho+2epsilon+rho=3rho+2epsilon+2epsilon rho<=4(rho+epsilon)=4e, because epsilon<=1/4. No constant depends on n.
